title: Gauteng MEC for Education launches school nutrition programme in Soweto
body: The Gauteng Department of Education has launched the 2026 school nutrition programme at Orlando High School. The programme aims to provide meals to over 600,000 learners across the province.

title: Soweto residents urged to report illegal water connections
body: Johannesburg Water has called on Soweto residents to report illegal water connections which are costing the municipality millions in lost revenue and causing supply disruptions.

title: JMPD arrests 12 suspects in Soweto drug bust operation
body: The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department conducted a successful drug bust in Diepkloof, Soweto, arresting 12 suspects and seizing drugs worth an estimated R500,000.

title: Road safety operation in Soweto this weekend
body: JMPD will conduct road safety operations across Soweto this weekend, focusing on drunk driving, unlicensed vehicles, and pedestrian safety. Motorists urged to comply.

title: Eskom implements Stage 4 load shedding due to generation losses
body: Eskom has moved to Stage 4 load shedding until further notice due to multiple generation unit failures. Soweto residents advised to check their block schedules.
